Wilderness survival

BLACKPINE

Gather, build a claim, and keep a rating the island does not forget. A tool cupboard holds the ground around it. Smelt sulphur and charcoal into gunpowder. Every fifth night the crew comes for the cupboard.

MoveWASD and mouse. On a phone, the stick and a drag to look.
RatingScavenge, hunt, build, and blood. Heat sizes the raid.
Raid toolsCraft guns and traps, grow crops, and crack keycard rooms with a fuse. Settlers claim a cupboard and build their own camp with a cupboard room, workshop, loot room, bedrooms, a furnace, windmill, battery and corner turrets.
